sources.title: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana Government Resolution
sources.authority: Women & Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
sources.summary: Official GR instituting monthly DBT of ₹1,500 for eligible women aged 21-65 residing in Maharashtra with annual household income <= ₹2.5 lakh.

sources.title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme Guidelines (MahaDBT)
sources.authority: Higher & Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
sources.summary: Reimbursement of tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowances for SC/ST/OBC/SBC/VJNT/EWS students pursuing post-matriculation studies.

sources.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi & Namo Shetkari Guidelines
sources.authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India & Agriculture Dept, GoM
sources.summary: Annual financial support of ₹12,000 in 3 installments for landholding farmer families in Maharashtra with Aadhaar e-KYC.

sources.title: Passport Rules 1980 & Citizen Charter (Passport Seva)
sources.authority: Consular, Passport & Visa Division, Ministry of External Affairs
sources.summary: Guidelines for issuance of Ordinary Fresh and Re-issue Passports under Normal and Tatkaal quotas, list of acceptable documents for address, identity and Non-ECR.

sources.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana & BSBDA Master Circular
sources.authority: Reserve Bank of India & Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
sources.summary: Zero-balance Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account guidelines, Rupay debit card with ₹2L accidental insurance, and simplified KYC.
